# Cambridge Dictionary

> Cambridge Dictionary is a comprehensive online dictionary, thesaurus, and translation platform offering English definitions, multilingual translations, grammar guides, and interactive learning tools for language learners of all levels.

Cambridge Dictionary provides free and premium access to extensive English language resources including multiple dictionary variants (Learner's, Essential, and full English), pronunciation guides, grammar references, and a translation tool supporting 19 languages. The platform serves both casual users and serious language learners through its Cambridge Dictionary +Plus subscription service.

## Key Topics

- English Dictionary
- Translation Tool

## Core Dictionary Resources

- [Cambridge Dictionary Homepage](https://dictionary.cambridge.org): Homepage for Cambridge Dictionary with English definitions, translations, and thesaurus.
- [Cambridge English Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english): Cambridge English Dictionary with definitions, pronunciations, and translations.
- [Cambridge Free English Dictionary and Thesaurus](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary): Main Cambridge English Dictionary with multiple variants and language learning resources.
- [Cambridge Learner's Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/learner-english): Cambridge Learner's Dictionary for intermediate English learners with examples.
- [Cambridge Essential British English Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/essential-british-english): Essential British English Dictionary for beginner learners with core vocabulary.
- [Cambridge Essential American English Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/essential-american-english): Essential American English Dictionary for beginner learners with core vocabulary.

## Translation & Multilingual Dictionaries

- [Cambridge Translator](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/translate): Free online translator supporting 19 languages with dictionary integration.
- [English–Chinese (Simplified) Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-chinese-simplified): Bilingual English-Mandarin Chinese dictionary with simplified character translations.
- [Chinese (Simplified)–English Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/chinese-simplified-english): Bilingual Mandarin-English dictionary with simplified characters and IELTS prep.
- [English–Chinese (Traditional) Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-chinese-traditional): Bilingual English-Traditional Chinese dictionary with advanced vocabulary.
- [Chinese (Traditional)–English Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/chinese-traditional-english): Bilingual Traditional Chinese-English dictionary for exam preparation.
- [English–Danish Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-danish): Bilingual English-Danish dictionary for translation and vocabulary reference.

## Grammar, Pronunciation & Reference

- [English Grammar Today](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar): English Grammar Today reference guide for British and American grammar rules.
- [Pronunciation Guide](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/pronunciation): Audio pronunciation guide for English words in British and American English.
- [Cambridge Thesaurus](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/thesaurus): Cambridge Thesaurus with synonyms, antonyms in British and American English.

## Learning Tools & Premium Features

- [Cambridge Dictionary +Plus](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/plus): Premium subscription service with quizzes, word lists, and AI learning tools.
- [Games Hub](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/games): Interactive games hub for vocabulary practice and English language learning.
- [My Profile](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/auth/profile): User profile and account management for Cambridge Dictionary +Plus subscribers.

## Help & Documentation

- [Cambridge Dictionary +Plus Help](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/howto.html): Help guide for using Cambridge Dictionary +Plus features and word lists.
